skill.summary: Structured long-term memory for AI agents with fact curation, conflict detection, importance scoring, timeline reconstruction, and OpenClaw integration.

latestVersion.changelog: v0.3.1 — Setup wizard + persistent config. One command install: `mindclaw setup` configures workspace, agent name, and registers with OpenClaw/Claude Desktop. New `setup_mindclaw` MCP tool for agent-driven onboarding. Settings persist in ~/.mindclaw/config.json (priority: CLI flag > env var > config > default).
